info.name: Xiaomi Galaxy FDS Access Control Chat API

items.docs: Creates a chat completion response from the specified MiMo model. The API is OpenAI-compatible and supports streaming, function calling, and multi-turn conversations. Available models include mimo-v2.5-pro, mimo-v2.5, mimo-v2-pro, mimo-v2-omni, mimo-v2-flash, and TTS variants.
